config.label: Port on 127
config.description: Port on 127.0.0.1 the Premiere Pro plugin connects to. Default 3011; set the same port in the plugin panel

config.label: Shared secret the plugin must send to connect (enter it in the plugin panel)
config.description: Shared secret the plugin must send to connect (enter it in the plugin panel). PREMIERE_BRIDGE_TOKEN overrides it

config.label: Extra directories allowed for file operations (':' on macOS, ';' on Windows)
config.description: Extra directories allowed for file operations (':' on macOS, ';' on Windows)

config.label: How long to wait for Premiere Pro before reporting that a dialog may be open
config.description: How long to wait for Premiere Pro before reporting that a dialog may be open. Default 120000

config.label: How long a call waits for the plugin to connect before failing
config.description: How long a call waits for the plugin to connect before failing. Default 4000
